neighbours.label: head noun completing a modifier + noun phrase ('nuclear reactor', 'magnificent stones', 'general health', 'Chinese workers'); no clear trigger found
fire: The town was built in the shadow of a huge nuclear reactor.
The quarry yields some of the most beautiful stones in Europe.
A daily walk is a simple way to protect your general health.
The new rules stopped foreign workers from renewing their visas.
The museum displays some of the most precious gems ever cut.
Protesters gathered outside the gates of the atomic plant.
Doctors monitor liver damage in chronic HCV patients.
The factory hired seasonal laborers during the harvest.
quiet: The town was built in the shadow of a huge mountain range.
The quarry closed after the owners ran out of money.
A daily walk is a simple way to meet your neighbors.
The new rules stopped anyone from renewing early.
The museum opens at nine and closes at five.
Protesters gathered outside and sang until midnight.
Doctors monitor patients who have had the virus for years.
The factory closed early during the harvest.

notes: Card: no single token: ' reactor' after 'Three Mile Island nuclear', ' stones', ' health' after 'better general', 'CV' in HCV, ' workers' after 'Chinese'; the + pole fires on the modifiers themselves (' with' low, ' chronic', ' higher'), so the - pole may be the noun that closes such a phrase. Probes did not support it: close paraphrases of four top examples, short and long, scored 0.02-0.07. This test records the best guess and is expected to fail.
